answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 13930 Country: India Title: If we make sadka e jariya its ajar we get after death till that act is continued is it same in case of zakat? Did we recive its ajar after death till that act is continue? Question: If we make sadka e jariya its ajar we get after death till that act is continued is it same in case of zakat? Did we recive its ajar after death till that act is continue? Answer ID: 13930 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 995/801=L/1430) The scholars of hadith have included waqf and other similar things in sadgah jariyah i.e. the reward of which continues even after death. (For details see: Mirqaatul Mafateeh) This ruling does not apply to zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
